title: Deliver Livestock to Great Flebourne Factory
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Livestock** delivered to **Great Flebourne Factory** (industry id 15, near tile 12,23).

A likely supplier is **Great Flebourne Farm** (industry id 14, near tile 33,32); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **18,000 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
